greeting.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
text: Mind the third board. It's been meaning to drop somebody all week and I'd rather it wasn't a guest.
Don't touch the pots. Two of them are supper and I've forgotten which.
Ah. Boots, iron, and a question. Always in that order.

options.text: You're a wizard, in a bog.
What's the fen been giving up lately?
That charm on the post is drawn wrong. Whoever cut it was copying from memory.
Buy your village a dry winter.

again.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
text: The third board went. Took the tax collector. I've decided that's magic and I'm not hearing otherwise.
You're back, and the fen didn't keep you. It usually insists.
I put the kettle on when the ducks got restless. They were right, as ever.

options.text: What's the water said since we left?
That banner nobody could read. Have you got further with it?
Look at us and tell me what you see.

the_bog.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
the_bog.text: The bog was here before the wizard. I only learned to argue with it. Some seasons I even win.

the_water.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
the_water.text: Boots without feet. A saddle without a horse. And last week, a banner nobody here can read. Take that how you like.

read_the_charm.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
read_the_charm.text: ...It is. I cut it in the dark with the water coming up. If you can see that, you can see what's coming out of the gates — stay a while.

misread_the_charm.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
misread_the_charm.text: It's drawn for a fen, not a book. Different grammar out here.

paid.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
paid.text: Then I'll buy tar with it, and the tar will buy the winter. That's most of what magic is.

the_useless.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
the_useless.text: Here: a word that makes still water ring like a struck cup. Does nothing. Frightens herons. I've had forty years out of it.

the_banner.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
the_banner.text: I've got as far as knowing it isn't a language. It's a list. Somebody was writing down places, and we were on it.

the_reading.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
the_reading.text: People who've begun to be a thing that happens to places, rather than people who arrive at them. Sit down. That's not a compliment, it's a warning.

no_reading.speaker: Wick the Duck Wizard
no_reading.text: Tired, wet, and hoping I'll say something grand. I'm a bog wizard, not a mirror.
